paragraphs.text: Cow is a seldom used acorn and playtest creature type for cards which depict a species of large, domestic bovine.
Cow debuted as a creature type in Unglued and has yet to reappear in any other un-set. It later re-appeared on the Dairy Cow playtest card in Mystery Booster 2 .

Black-bordered cards tend to use the Ox creature type for non-humanoid bovines and Minotaur for humanoid bovines. Bartered Cows are traded on Eldraine while Holy Cows have been seen on Thunder Junction . Mark Rosewater has been been pushing for Ox to be changed to Cow for years, but without any success.
